profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.headline: I build enterprise software and automate the workflows behind it.
profile.intro: Software Engineer at Newgen Software Technologies working with Java, Spring Boot and workflow automation using iBPS and BRMS. B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (CGPA 8.6).
profile.bio:
I'm Sakiv, a Software Engineer at Newgen Software Technologies. I develop and maintain enterprise applications with Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript and SQL, and I design workflows and business rules with Newgen iBPS, Process Designer and BRMS to streamline business operations.

I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Jaypee University Anoopshahr (CGPA 8.6). I joined Newgen as a Software Engineer Intern in January 2025 and moved into a full-time Software Engineer role in July 2025.

Beyond work, I build full-stack web projects with React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB, and I keep my problem-solving sharp by practising data structures and algorithms in Java on LeetCode and GeeksforGeeks.

highlights: Developed and maintained enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript and SQL, ensuring scalable and high-performance solutions for business clients.
Designed and implemented workflows and business rules using Newgen iBPS, Process Designer and BRMS to streamline operational processes and improve efficiency.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs, backend utilities and responsive UI components to support seamless system integration and an enhanced user experience.
Performed debugging, manual testing and API validation using Postman while ensuring application quality, performance and timely delivery of project requirements.
Assisted in developing and maintaining enterprise applications using Java, SQL and JavaScript, supporting workflow automation and backend processes.
Worked on implementing business workflows and validating APIs using Postman to ensure smooth system integration and functionality.
Supported debugging, testing and issue resolution activities to improve application performance and user experience.
Collaborated with development and business teams while gaining hands-on experience in enterprise software solutions and SDLC practices.

projects.title: E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-featured e-commerce web application where users can browse and purchase products, search by category and price, and manage profiles through login and signup pages. Includes banners for special offers, add-to-cart and remove-from-cart functionality, and secure payment processing integrated with the Stripe API.
